I wrote the CSV parser in `main.wj`. It builds with `wj run --compiled`. I ran it on a test input that combines both of your examples, and the output matched what you expected.

It reads each line as one record. It handles quoted fields with commas, `""` as a literal quote, and an empty line as one empty field. It also drops a stray `\r`, in case a line ends in a Windows-style newline.
